ir.evidence: A black component with two legs (IR LED) is located on the breadboard near row 20.

ir_pin.evidence: A yellow wire connects the row of the IR LED to pin 12 on the Arduino.

fire_led.evidence: A red LED is present on the breadboard near row 35.

fire_resistor.evidence: A resistor is connected in the same row as the red LED's leg.

led_polarity.evidence: The red LED is oriented with the longer leg (anode) connected to the signal path.

buzzer.evidence: A black circular buzzer is located on the breadboard near row 30.

gnd_other_end.evidence: The black wire from the GND pin connects to the negative power rail on the breadboard.
